CJP alleges 13 crore voter deletions, targets PM Modi

The Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) has alleged that 13 crore voters have been deleted from electoral rolls, a move they claim is intended to sway upcoming polls. CJP's Dipke has criticized this action, stating that unfurling the tricolour is not a crime and has targeted Prime Minister Modi, suggesting the deletions amount to a 'setting' to manipulate election outcomes.
